title: 4BR Rosemary Beach Vacation Rental with Gulf Views
meta_description: Stay in this 4BR, 4.5BA Rosemary Beach vacation rental with private beach access, Gulf views, 6 beach cruiser bikes, and a private courtyard. Sleeps 12.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Terra Casa Cottage & Carriage House
normalized_matching_profile.description: DescriptionWith the shimmering turquoise of the Gulf of Mexico a few steps to the south and the vibrant jade of the Eastern Green to the front, the brilliant coral-colored oasis of Terra Casa Cottage & Carriage House stands out like a sparkling jewel in Rosemary Beach. Once inside, soothing neutrals and tranquil blues transport you to a serene state of mind where all your stresses seem to melt away. Boasting four bedrooms, garage parking, a private courtyard, and an absolutely sublime central location, Terra Casa Cottage & Carriage House is the perfect place to escape the everyday— and immerse yourself in laid-back coastal luxury.In the cottage, the main level is airy and bright, with exposed heart pine beams overhead and blond oak wood floors. The walls are bathed in soothing pale blue and crisp white, creating a lovely, calming palette. In the living space, a plush sofa and armchairs face the wood-burning fireplace and HDTV. Next to the living area is a spacious dining area with seating for eight.The coastal blue and white color scheme continue in the kitchen, where crisp white double-stacked cabinets are balanced with dramatic, glossy black quartz countertops. The efficient u-shape design of the kitchen includes a double refrigerator, electric range, microwave, and dishwasher. The kitchen is also conveniently located close to the garage entrance, allowing for effortless delivery of groceries and other supplies.French doors from the kitchen lead outside to the delightful courtyard, reminiscent of a home in the French Quarter. Covered by a shady arbor wrapped in lush flowing vines, there’s space here for relaxing and dining alfresco, or simply sipping a glass of wine while enjoying the gentle sea breeze.Terra Casa Cottage includes four serene bedrooms spaces— all located on the second level. The first is a primary suite, with a regal king-size bed, HDTV, sunny balcony, and spa-like ensuite bathroom. A secondary bedroom suite also houses a luxe king-size bed, HDTV, a terrace with views of the gulf and the green, and an attached full bathroom. The next bedroom is a bunk room, complete with a full-over-full-size bunk bed. Another bedroom also boasts a king-size bed, soaring cathedral ceilings, an HDTV, a sleeper sofa, and a full ensuite bathroom.Overlooking the sprawling Eastern Green and the gorgeous Gulf of Mexico, a stay at Terra Casa Cottage & Carriage House feels like an escape to an opulent beachfront estate. You’ll never be more than a few steps away from the sugary white sand of the beach, while also being a short bike ride or a stroll away from a leisurely lunch or a late-night bite in town. Plus the stunning Coquina Community Swimming Pool is right around the corner. For your next heavenly stay on 30A, look no further than Terra Casa.PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:* Professionally designed* Gulf views* Walk to the beach in Seconds* Overlooking the Eastern Green* Private courtyard* Garage parking* 6 Complimentary Beach Cruiser BikesHOME LAYOUT: (Sleeps 12)FIRST FLOOR* Grand GREAT ROOM with combined LIVING & DINING spaces* Gourmet KITCHEN * Private, shaded COURTYARD* GARAGE parking* LAUNDRY ROOMSECOND FLOOR* PRIMARY SUITE with king-size bed and ENSUITE BATH (Sleeps 2)* SECONDARY SUITE with king-size bed and ENSUITE BATH (Sleeps 2)* GUEST BEDROOM with full-over-full-size bunk bed (Sleeps 4)* Multiple BALCONIES with ocean viewsCARRIAGE HOUSE* GUEST BEDROOM with king-size bed, sleeper sofa, and ENSUITE BATH (Sleeps 4)* Full Kitchenette with oven/range, dishwasher, mini-fridge* GARAGE parking
